Method of Attack: Exploits targeting misconfigured SAP NetWeaver installations (including S4/HANA) to achieve full system compromise without requiring valid SAP user ID and password
Abuse of critical configuration issues in SAP NetWeaver installations
Remote exploitation by unauthenticated attackers via network access to vulnerable SAP production systems

Performing critical business transactions, creating fake vendors/employees, modifying purchase orders, changing bank accounts, paying vendors/employees, releasing shipments, changing inventory data, generating corrupted reports, bypassing automatic business controls
Impacted Systems: SAP GRC Process and Access Control
Attack Vector: Network access to vulnerable SAP production systems with misconfigured SAP Gateway or SAP Message Server Access Control Lists
Indicators of Compromise: Open source Snort signatures released by Onapsis Research Labs for detection
Publicly released exploits following April 2019 OPCDE Security Conference
